title: Avro Lancaster PB366 - Pillar
memorial_details: A 4 sided rough hewn stone pillar with a pyramidal top mounted on a concrete base in a surround of white stones. At the top of the pillar is a metal sculpture of an eagle with wings aloft, and on the front face a bronze plaque bearing the dedication and names of the crew.
inscription: Plaque: (RAF crest)/ Dedicated to the memory and bravery/ of the crew of Lancaster PB366/ which crashed in Great Paxton on/ Christmas Eve 1944/ with the loss of all seven young lives./ (Names)/ The bright beloved marauders of the sky/ PER ARDUA AD ASTRA
